name: The Arboretum
summary: The Arboretum is Austin's premier bi-level outdoor lifestyle center featuring upscale clothing stores, art galleries, and diverse dining options along Research Boulevard. This sophisticated shopping destination combines market-exclusive brands with locally owned specialty shops, offering an elevated retail experience in Northwest Austin.
demographics: The Arboretum attracts an affluent, educated demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle to high-income households from Northwest Austin and surrounding areas. The typical visitor base includes professionals aged 30-55 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, along with younger millennials and Gen Z shoppers drawn to the upscale retail and dining options. The trade area serves a well-educated population with a high percentage of college graduates working in Austin's thriving tech sector, who value quality shopping experiences and are willing to pay premium prices for specialty goods and experiential dining.
description: The Arboretum stands as Austin's premier upscale outdoor shopping destination, offering a sophisticated bi-level retail experience along Research Boulevard in the heart of Northwest Austin. This lifestyle center seamlessly blends market-exclusive brands with locally owned specialty shops, creating an unparalleled shopping environment that caters to discerning tastes. The center's carefully curated tenant mix includes fashion retailers like Jos A Bank and Soma Intimates, entertainment options such as Barnes & Noble and GameStop, and unique specialty stores like Savory Spice and Con Olio Oils & Vinegars. Dining at The Arboretum is a culinary adventure, featuring everything from the globally-inspired menu at The Cheesecake Factory to authentic Italian cuisine at Juliet Italian Kitchen, Brazilian steakhouse fare at Estancia, and sweet treats at Amy's Ice Creams. Beyond shopping and dining, visitors can indulge in wellness and pampering services at Beleza Surgery and Organic Nails & Lash Spa, making The Arboretum a true one-stop destination for lifestyle, leisure, and luxury in Austin.
